item.israel_simulator.kippah.requirement: Required for prayer at the Western Wall.
item.israel_simulator.talit.desc: Traditional Jewish prayer shawl with tzitzit fringes.
item.israel_simulator.talit.bonus: Provides spiritual resistance and luck when worn.
item.israel_simulator.tefillin.requireme: Bound during daylight while wearing a Kippah.

message.israel_simulator.kosher_violatio: You feel unwell from mixing meat and dairy.

Hold a Prayer Note in your hand to place a prayer into the Western Wall.
message.israel_simulator.western_wall_co: You have already placed a prayer note recently. Please return later.
message.israel_simulator.western_wall_bl: Your prayer has been placed into the sacred stones. You have been blessed!
message.israel_simulator.tefillin_need_k: You must wear a Kippah on your head to bind Tefillin.
message.israel_simulator.tefillin_not_da: Tefillin is traditionally bound during morning and daytime hours.
message.israel_simulator.tefillin_cooldo: You have recently concluded Tefillin prayer. Allow time before binding again.
message.israel_simulator.tefillin_blesse: You bind the Tefillin for morning prayer, receiving spiritual fortitude.
message.israel_simulator.tefillin_talit_: With Kippah, Talit, and Tefillin united, you receive a full morning prayer blessing!
message.israel_simulator.ark_need_kippah: Cover your head with a Kippah before prayer at the Aron Kodesh.
message.israel_simulator.ark_cooldown: You have reflected at the holy ark recently. Take time for contemplation.
message.israel_simulator.ark_prayer_comp: You pray before the Aron Kodesh, feeling peace and clarity.
message.israel_simulator.ark_offering_co: You placed an offering before the Aron Kodesh. A rich blessing is bestowed upon you!
item.israel_simulator.dreidel.desc: Traditional Hanukkah spinning top. Right-click to spin for Shekels!
item.israel_simulator.shofar.desc: Sacred musical ram's horn. Right-click to blast and receive a New Year blessing.
message.israel_simulator.dreidel_win: Miracle! You won %d Shekels from the Hanukkah pot!
message.israel_simulator.shofar_blast: Teki'ah Gedolah! The piercing blast of the Shofar awakens the soul!
message.israel_simulator.blessed_trader_: Shalom! The holy light of a blessed traveler shines upon you. Behold my sacred wares!
message.israel_simulator.menorah_lit: You lit candle #%d on the Menorah.
message.israel_simulator.menorah_fully_l: All eight lights are glowing with miraculous radiance! Chag Hanukkah Sameach!
message.israel_simulator.menorah_extingu: The Menorah candles have been gently extinguished.
item.israel_simulator.first_amendment.de: Historic charter of free speech, assembly, and open debate.
item.israel_simulator.first_amendment.ef: Right-click to claim the Freedom effect, breaking free of slowness and restraint.
message.israel_simulator.first_amendment: You proclaim freedom of thought and assembly! You feel completely unburdened and free!
message.israel_simulator.public_speech_r: You actively participated in the Civic Speech and stood for free expression! You received the First Amendment!
message.israel_simulator.public_speech_s: [Public Forum] A civic speech on democracy and liberty is now commencing at the forum!
item.israel_simulator.rabbis_crown.desc: Sacred mythic crown worn by revered spiritual sages.
item.israel_simulator.rabbis_crown.effec: Bestows permanent Blessed Trader aura upon the wearer.
item.israel_simulator.hava_nagila_disc.l: LEGENDARY Boss Reward — Let us rejoice and be glad!
message.israel_simulator.bibi_boss_defea: Bibi has been defeated! The legendary Hava Nagila music disc drops upon the floor!
speech.israel_simulator.bibi_boss.quote_: "Together we will win! The coalition stands firm and unbroken!"
"I have guided this land through storm and sun. You cannot unseat me!"
"No weapon formed against our podium shall prosper! Filibuster!"
advancements.israel_simulator.hava_nagil: Defeat the formidable Bibi Boss and claim the legendary Hava Nagila music disc!
item.israel_simulator.rav_kav.status: Rav-Kav valid: Unlimited regional transit pass active.
item.israel_simulator.rav_kav.desc: Official smart travel card for Israeli public transportation.
item.israel_simulator.rav_kav.unlimited: Provides free rides on buses, trains, and ferries.
item.israel_simulator.walking_shoes.desc: Sturdy leather walking shoes for long overland hikes and city tours.
item.israel_simulator.walking_shoes.effe: Grants swift movement speed while travelling.
item.israel_simulator.israel_map.desc: Cartographic map tracking visited regions and discovered landmarks.
item.israel_simulator.israel_map.usage: Right-click to inspect your exploration progress and discovered sites.
message.israel_simulator.transit_cooldow: Please wait %d seconds before boarding public transit again.

advancements.israel_simulator.blessed_tr: Equip the Rabbi's Crown and receive the divine Blessed Trader discount aura.
advancements.israel_simulator.freedom_of: Participate in the public debate forum and receive the First Amendment charter.
